copayment.display: None (₹10,000 per claim deductible for overseas claims)
copayment.note: Per claim deductible of ₹10,000 applies for each overseas claim

sub_limits.note: All covers up to Sum Insured; overseas claims capped at Base SI + Plus Benefit

deductible.display: None (optional aggregate deductible for India claims)
deductible.note: Optional aggregate deductible from ₹10K to ₹25L for India claims only

ped_waiting.display: 36 months (reducible to 12mo via optional channel-level add-on)

cumulative_bonus.note: Plus Benefit (50% of BSI/yr up to 100%) is inbuilt

restoration.note: Triggers on partial or complete exhaustion; India only for restoration

ambulance.display: Covered up to SI (road & air ambulance)

global_cover.note: Global Health Cover (Emergency Treatments Only) inbuilt; planned treatments not covered overseas

notable_exclusions: Maternity, planned overseas treatments, oncological diseases overseas, orthopaedic conditions overseas (except fractures), congenital external anomalies, OPD treatment
optional_riders: Aggregate deductible, Overseas Travel Secure, Emergency Air Ambulance, Daily Cash for Shared Room, PED wait modification, Critical Illness add-on, Parenthood add-on
